children.text: At TRECIG, our team is the backbone of every success story. Comprised of industry experts, innovative problem solvers, and mission driven professionals, we bring together diverse talents to meet the unique needs of our clients.

Our team is built on a foundation of excellence, resilience, and a shared passion for solving complex cybersecurity and technological challenges. From seasoned veterans with decades of experience to forward thinking innovators driving new efficiencies, we work as a cohesive unit to ensure every mission is executed flawlessly.

What sets the TRECIG team apart is our unwavering commitment to our clients’ goals. We take the time to understand your vision, aligning our strategies to deliver solutions that exceed expectations. With expertise spanning cybersecurity, technology, and project management. We tackle each challenge with precision and dedication.

At TRECIG, we don’t just deliver results, we build relationships, foster collaboration, and create legacies. Our team is here to ensure that your mission is not only accomplished but elevated to its fullest potential.

children.text: Before retiring from a 30+ year career in the US Army, Dr. Rucker started TRECIG, LLC as a platform to utilize his vast knowledge of IT and CYBER Security Operations. He is an experienced CEO, CTO, and team builder skilled in IT and cyber business development, mentoring, business process improvement, cross functional team development, marketing, strategic operational planning, facilitation and conflict resolution, and IT service management.

Dr. Rucker’s 30+ years of Army service afforded him the opportunity to serve in many positions at all levels, as well as allowing him to serve in diverse locations geographically dispersed around the world. He retired as a Chief Warrant Officer 5.
He holds a Bachelor of Science degree in Information Systems Management, Master of Science degree in Leadership and Management and a Doctor of Business Administration in Leadership (DBA).
"A true leader has the confidence to stand alone, the courage to make tough decision, and the compassion to listen to the needs of others" -Douglas MacArthur

children.text: Martha Key serves as President of TRECIG, LLC, providing executive leadership for the company’s strategic operations, organizational growth, and mission execution across defense, federal, and commercial markets. In this role, she is responsible for translating corporate strategy into operational excellence, strengthening enterprise performance, cultivating strategic partnerships, and ensuring the successful delivery of innovative solutions that support the company’s expanding portfolio. Previously serving as TRECIG’s Chief Acquisitions and Procurement Officer, Martha earned her appointment as President through a demonstrated record of exceptional leadership, operational discipline, and a steadfast commitment to advancing the company’s long-term vision.

A retired U.S. Army Chief Warrant Officer Four (CW4) with more than 22 years of distinguished military service, Martha is recognized for her ability to lead complex organizations, optimize enterprise supply chains, and drive operational excellence across high-performing teams.

Martha holds a Bachelor of Science in Business Administration and a Master of Business Administration (MBA), and she is currently pursuing a Doctor of Business Administration (DBA) with a specialization in Supply Chain Management and Logistics.
